title: Ordinary Time With You
north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.

golden_theme_contract.first_principles_rule: Before submitting or scoring any new carousel idea, use these source files as the first-principles explanation of why the gold carousel worked: universal anti-ideal -> concrete Aachu proof -> Zuv steady response -> tender acceptance thesis.
golden_theme_contract.rule: Every carousel must start from a universal relationship truth, then prove it through Aachu/Zuv specifics. Photos, places, outfits, and objects are evidence, not the premise.
hard_fail_if: The concept is primarily about an object, outfit, location, or photo aesthetic.
A stranger could not send the carousel to a partner without knowing the private photo context.
Aachu's expressive role is missing or mocked.
Zuv's calm role is passive, absent, or treated as background.
The concept is mostly about taking photos, looking beautiful, glowing, or waiting for one more picture without a deeper relationship tension.
One partner's role is only looking good while the other waits or holds things.
The final thesis is generic romance without a concrete proof trail.
default_five_slide_map: Universal hook: one swipe-stopping relationship truth.
Aachu-specific reveal: her version of the truth.
Concrete proof: a drawable behavior, object, or ritual from the reference material.
Zuv role: what his calm, patience, care, or choice does emotionally.
Save/share thesis: the tender truth underneath the joke.
caption_formula: Open with the universal relationship truth.
Show the couple-specific behavior, care, posture, object, or rhythm in the middle; name Aachu/Zuv only when natural.
End with a soft send/save-worthy thesis.

human_truth: Long distance does not only make a couple miss big romantic moments; it makes them miss the boring, useless, ordinary time they would have wasted together if they were in the same room.
emotional_arc: long-distance ache -> tiny future-plan banter -> cooking/board-game/cab receipts -> Zuv joins the small wish -> ordinary-time thesis
source_story_summary: Long distance makes you miss boring things, not only dates or trips. If there was no long distance, the two of them would be texting tiny future plans: cooking together even though it is a terrible idea, board game night with invented rules after losing, and being secretly happy the cab is late because it buys a few more minutes. The emotional truth: maybe they do not miss big dates; maybe they just miss wasting normal time together.
visual_style: Create a complete publishable @a.storyof.two social slide in the established Aachu/Zuv illustrated carousel look: soft hand-drawn flat vector warmth with desi storybook texture. Treat the first supplied style references as canonical character-model sheets: preserve the same recurring caricature faces, proportions, hair shapes, expressive eyes, beard/brow structure, handwritten lettering, warm paper texture, and soft desi storybook linework from the accepted earlier carousels. Use Product Unshipped-like simplicity adapted for a desi love story, but do not reinterpret the couple into a new generic illustration style. Use the provided identity and style references to create recurring illustrated versions of Aachu/Anchal and Zuv/Himanshu, not generic stock characters. Keep warm off-white paper, imperfect black outlines, slightly uneven strokes, matte muted colors, generous breathing room, expressive faces, detailed-but-soft Indian outfits when story-relevant, and one clear visual idea. Minimalism must still feel alive: keep a few tiny innocent micro-elements such as small hearts, blush marks, reaction ticks, tiny motion lines, soft thought/reaction bubbles, or one small care detail when they support the emotional beat. Render the exact slide copy as handwritten-style black text inside the artwork, and add the tiny low-contrast handwritten brandmark '@a.storyof.two' at bottom-right as part of the generated image.
target_voice: Aachu/Zuv archive voice: warm, specific, playful underneath the tenderness

"We should cook together."
"That's a terrible idea."
"Exactly."

"Board game night?"
"Only if you don't invent rules after losing."

"Cab is 12 minutes late."
"Best news all day."

"Maybe I don't miss big dates."
"Maybe I just miss wasting normal time with you."

candidates.name: Ordinary Time With You
candidates.universal_truth: If there were no long distance, the romance would be the tiny normal things they finally get to waste together.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu turns imaginary plans into pure private-text banter: cooking badly, board games, and being happy that the cab is late.
candidates.concrete_proof: The message thread keeps cutting to tiny imagined scenes they cannot do in the same room yet, with the emotion hidden under teasing replies.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv answers every small plan like it matters and lets the boring thing become a love language.
candidates.tender_thesis: Maybe I just miss wasting normal time with you.

candidates.name: We Don't Miss Dates. We Miss Tuesdays.
candidates.universal_truth: The ache of distance is not always missing special plans; it is missing the tiny unspecial rituals.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu names small plans with dramatic seriousness.
candidates.concrete_proof: Cooking, board-game competitiveness, and delayed-cab relief.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv joins the silly future tense instead of dismissing it.
candidates.tender_thesis: Love is wanting the same boring day.

candidates.name: The Plans Were Tiny
candidates.universal_truth: When two people are apart, tiny plans become proof that the relationship still has a room to live in.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu collects tiny plans like future receipts.
candidates.concrete_proof: The phone thread becomes a kitchen, a game board, and a rainy cab wait.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv keeps the imaginary room open by replying with warmth.
candidates.tender_thesis: The smallest plans can hold the biggest missing.

candidates.name: The Cab Can Be Late
candidates.universal_truth: Sometimes the most romantic thing is not arriving fast; it is getting a few extra minutes together.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu secretly hopes the cab is late because leaving hurts.
candidates.concrete_proof: Rain, umbrella, phone glow, and both people quietly glad about the delay.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv admits the same soft wish instead of playing practical.
candidates.tender_thesis: Some delays are just love buying time.

candidates.name: Board Games Across A Phone
candidates.universal_truth: Couples in distance still fight, tease, and keep score over ordinary things they cannot do yet.
candidates.aachu_specific_spark: Aachu's competitive softness turns a board game into a future scene.
candidates.concrete_proof: A board-game table imagined underneath the chat bubbles.
candidates.zuv_role: Zuv teases her gently while keeping the shared future alive.
candidates.tender_thesis: Missing someone can look like planning a fight you want to have.
